  Alina has been an active part of the WordPress community for over a decade, contributing as an organizer, speaker, volunteer, and passionate advocate since the early days of WordCamps in Nepal. From her early involvement in 2012 to today, she has remained deeply engaged in nurturing and empowering the WordPress community.

  With years of experience as a developer, team lead, and project manager, Alina has recently embarked on her entrepreneurial journey and is working with dedication to make it a success.

  Passionate about WordPress and open source, she’s committed to giving back, supporting collaboration, and helping create inclusive spaces for contributors worldwide. Outside of work and community, Alina loves exploring new places and meeting new people.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/mumtahina-faguni/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-59034c991a42d9e7f9df165e32c15fbc wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Mumtahina Faguni &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Mumtahina Faguni</span></a>
  Mumtahina Faguni is a passionate WordCamper and tech enthusiast with a vibrant zest for exploring new ideas, cultures, and communities. Deeply inspired by the collaborative spirit of open source, she has been actively involved in the WordPress community for years, attending and volunteering at multiple WordCamps across Asia. Some of her core milestones with WordPress and WordCamps include serving as the WordPress 6.7 Docs Release Lead, being an Organizer for WordCamp Asia 2025, WordCamp Dhaka, speaking at WordCamp Pokhara and WordCamp Sylhet, and volunteering at several other WordCamps. From her very first WordCamp experience to her ongoing involvement in global WordPress initiatives, she has embraced every opportunity to learn, collaborate, and give back to the community she loves.

  Alongside her volunteering journey, Faguni has built a strong professional career in the WordPress ecosystem for over 7 years. She has contributed to the growth of more than 15 innovative WordPress products while working at Startise. Her expertise spans content strategy, product marketing, growth hacking, and community engagement. Known for her thoughtful communication style and deep understanding of user needs, she brings creativity and strategic insight to every project.

  Beyond tech, her curiosity fuels a love for travel, storytelling, and building meaningful human connections.

  </div>

  I started using WordPress in 2013, and it has been a big part of my work ever since.\
  Although I spent many years as a freelance web designer, these days I mainly work as a babysitter.

  I live in Tokyo, Japan, where I’ve made many wonderful friends through the WordPress community and enjoyed joining regular meetups. I’ve also participated in WordCamp Tokyo as both an organizer and a speaker. Traveling abroad with community friends has been an amazing experience and has had a big impact on my life.

  India has always been one of the places I dreamed of visiting.\
  I’m really looking forward to meeting everyone!

  Vishal Mukadam is a WordPress Implementor and Designer who runs WPCounty, a web agency helping individuals, small businesses, and enterprises build fast, secure, and user-friendly WordPress websites. Active in the WordPress Mumbai community since 2015, he has contributed through marketing, photography, translation, and volunteering at WordCamps and meetups across India. Passionate about Full Site Editing (FSE) and SEO, Vishal enjoys helping others unlock the power of WordPress while fostering community growth.

  Mainul is a marketing strategist and data storyteller, working with WordPress products since 2016. He leads a 14-member marketing team at Roxnor, a WordPress product and SaaS company.

  He is currently pursuing a PhD in marketing, focusing on agile and AI-driven strategies for digital product promotion. Mainul has mentored, organized, volunteered, and spoken at WordCamps around the world.

  He has worked with companies like weDevs, Roxnor, XpeedStudio, LegalSheba, Wpmet, LifterLMS, WP Travel, Codezen Technologies, Staff Asia, Training Express, and One Education. He also contributes to the global WordPress Community Team as an Event Supporter.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/priyanka-adhikari/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-f2ea308fa43113011d748a6ee303fb70 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Priyanka Adhikari</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Priyanka Adhikari</span></a>
  Priyanka is an active contributor and organiser in the WordPress community, currently serving on the Communication and Design team for WordCamp Asia 2026. With a strong belief in open source and community-driven collaboration, she brings care, clarity, and creativity to how information and experiences are shaped for others.

  Her journey in the WordPress ecosystem began through volunteering and participating in meetups, community support, and WordCamp events around the world. Over time, she has taken on roles that help make WordPress more accessible and welcoming, whether that’s through organising sessions, mentoring contributors, or helping newcomers feel at home.

  For WordCamp Asia 2026, Priyanka focuses on creating communication and design that resonates with a diverse, global audience. She works to ensure that content is clear, inclusive, and easy to navigate, and that every attendee feels supported and informed.

  Outside of her contributions to WordPress, Priyanka works in technical operations and support leadership. She brings a systems-oriented, empathetic approach to all her work and is grateful to collaborate with organisers from across Asia and beyond to help make WordCamp Asia a meaningful and memorable experience.

  </div>

  Shruti Sona is an educator turned media and communication professional, a passionate content writer, and a storyteller who finds inspiration in everyday moments. A proud WordPress enthusiast, she actively contributes to the community and is one of the organizers of WordCamp Pune 2025.

  With a love for words, Shruti helps businesses build their voice through engaging and meaningful content. She believes every idea has a story waiting to be told, it just needs the right words to bring it to life.

  When she’s not writing or planning community events, you’ll find her exploring new digital trends, connecting with creative minds, or penning poetry that reflects her world of imagination.

  Sunita Rai is a passionate WordPress content marketer currently leading SiteSaga, a blog about WordPress and websites. Her work focuses on helping beginners and non-tech-savvy people build their online presence with WordPress, without needing any programming skills. She’s deeply inspired by the WordPress community, cherishing the friendships and connections made through events worldwide. An active WordPresser, Sunita has contributed as a co-organizer, speaker, and volunteer at WordCamps and meetups. Outside of work, she enjoys reading, meditation, hiking, and spending time in nature.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/ahmed-kabir-chaion/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-622b9325f07682d4d3b71229ca8b3709 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Ahmed Kabir Chaion &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Ahmed Kabir Chaion</span></a>
  Ahmed Kabir Chaion – The No-Code Advocate for WordPress

  Ahmed Kabir Chaion is a long-time WordPress Contributor, sponsored by Rocket.net, and currently serves as the WordPress Contributions Lead at Hosting.com. He is a Team Rep for Making WordPress Polyglots, a former Team Rep for Global Design, and an organizer for major events including WordCamp Asia (2023–2026) and WordCamp Dhaka 2025, as well as the Dhaka WordPress Meetup chapter.

  Ahmed has contributed to every major WordPress release since version 5.6 and has been recognized as a Noteworthy Contributor across multiple releases, including 5.8, 5.9, 6.0, 6.1, 6.3, 6.5, and 6.7. Beyond core contributions, he actively supports global community growth as a Community Event Supporter, Polyglots GTE, and mentor for local and international WordPress initiatives, including Campus Connect Dhaka 2025.

  Outside WordPress, Ahmed is a Diplomacy Mentor, collaborating with institutions in Bangladesh, Australia, and Nigeria. He supports students in preparing for language proficiency exams such as IELTS, TOEFL, and PTE. During the pandemic, he joined WEDU Global to mentor Asian women in advancing their academic and professional growth. He has also judged the Hult Prize On-Campus competitions (2019–20, 2020–21, 2024–25), the world’s largest student entrepreneurship event in partnership with the UN.

  Akshaya Rane has over a decade of experience in WordPress and works as a dedicated Project Manager at Multidots. She mentors her team, collaborates closely with clients, and helps bring their business goals to life through thoughtful project planning and execution.

  Passionate about the WordPress ecosystem, Akshaya contributes through meetups, WordCamps, Contributor Days, and the Community Giveaway program.From Core Contributor to WordCamp Speaker and Release Coordinator, she’s passionate about giving back and being part of the thriving community.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/anand-upadhyay/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-9a1696ad1fa98b7faf48ea3a3cebe95c wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Anand Upadhyay &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Anand Upadhyay</span></a>
  Anand Upadhyay is a long-time WordPress contributor and community advocate based in Ajmer, India. Active in the ecosystem since 2010, he has contributed to several Make WordPress teams including Core, Docs, Community, and Polyglots, with a strong focus on empowering others to get involved.

  He is the founder of WPVibes, a WordPress plugin development company that builds performance-driven tools for WordPress and WooCommerce users. Anand is also a regular WordCamp speaker, meetup organizer, and someone deeply committed to bringing WordPress education to students.

  In 2024, he helped launch the first WordPress Campus Connect event, which went on to become a global program officially recognized by the WordPress Foundation. Anand continues to support and mentor student communities through events, workshops, and open-source advocacy.

  </div>

  Jagir Bahesh is the Founder & CEO of Jpadweb, with over 10 years of experience in WordPress, digital transformation, and strategic consulting with White label service. He provides comprehensive web solutions for enterprise businesses, online publishers, and eCommerce platforms. Jagir began his career as a developer in 2015, building a strong technical foundation and becoming deeply involved in the WordPress community. He actively organizes and participates in WordCamps, collaborating with global industry leaders. Jagir is also a key member of the WordCamp Ahmedabad Organizing team and has contributed as an organizer at WordCamp Asia. Additionally, he leads an Online AI Community, fostering collaboration and innovation.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/krupa-nanda/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-d3aede6294c21ab65bdba263ff9a79a1 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Krupa Nanda &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Krupa Nanda</span></a>
  I’m Krupa, a QA Engineer with over seven years of experience testing and improving WordPress-based projects. Over the years, I’ve worn many hats from Project Coordinator to Release Manager; helping shape in-house plugins and add-ons while keeping quality at the heart of every release.

  I’m passionate about software quality, accessibility, and open source, and love being part of the WordPress community. I currently serve as an Accessibility Team Representative for Make WordPress, where I get to collaborate with contributors from around the world to make the web more inclusive for everyone.

  Beyond work, I’m a mother exploring the world of open learning and unschooling with my child. This approach deeply inspires how I view growth as a journey of curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning, both in life and in my career. My story is one of blending motherhood, community, and professional purpose; all rooted in resilience and a love for learning and sharing along the way.

  </div>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/makarand-mane/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-97b88d3862fb880c4082fcab4797605d wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Makarand Mane &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Makarand Mane</span></a>
  [Makarand G. Mane](https://www.makarandmane.com/) has been a passionate WordPress enthusiast since 2011. Starting as a freelance developer, he now leads [WPGenius Solutions LLP](https://wpgenius.in/), a trusted brand in WordPress services.

  As a General Translation Editor for Marathi, Speaker at various WordCamps, Lead organiser of [WordCamp Kolhapur 2025](https://kolhapur.wordcamp.org/2025/) and the organizer of the [Kolhapur WordPress Meetup](https://www.meetup.com/WPKolhapur/), Makarand actively contributes to the community. He also received a Diversity Scholarship to attend WordCamp Asia 2025. He conducts programming workshops and enjoys traveling, exploring cultures, and nurturing his spiritual side – qualities that have shaped his leadership as the lead organizer of WordCamp Kolhapur.

  Makarand’s efforts have inspired and strengthened local WordPress communities, making Kolhapur a hub for WordPress enthusiasts. His vision for WordCamp Kolhapur is to foster connections, share knowledge, and highlight the region’s vibrant culture.

  Beyond WordPress, he is dedicated to empowering the next generation of developers and believes in creating opportunities through education and mentorship.

  </div>

  Olga is a developer with over 16 years of experience in software support, marketing and web development. She is an active WordPress contributor, Codeable expert and fantasy writer.

  Olga has been contributing to WordPress since 2019, took part in several WordPress releases as Triage and Test co-lead and is an active participant of the Contributor Mentorship Program. She believes in open-source and is passionate about everything she does. She likes rock music and sharing knowledge.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/rakesh-lawaju/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-77a66759c9f443cddd3c1ea60882503a wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Rakesh Lawaju &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Rakesh Lawaju</span></a>
  Rakesh Lawaju is a web enthusiast, programmer, trainer, and entrepreneur based in Nepal who has been in the web field since 2008. He is the Founder and CEO of One Loop Studio Pvt. Ltd and was the co-founder and CTO of WEN Solutions. He had worked as the project lead for the WP Travel plugin and other multiple plugins and themes. He is now leading the Gutenberg plugin called Gutenify.com and also working as a consultant for numerous international companies.

  Rakesh has also worked for internationally renowned companies like 1E, WPMU DEV, and Graph Paper Press. In those companies, he has handled bigger projects, plugins, and themes.

  He was on the organizing team of WordCamp Kathmandu in 2016, 2017, and 2018, and WordCamp Nepal in 2022 and 2024. During the release of WordPress 4.4 “Clifford”, he contributed to the WordPress core and contributed to translating WordPress into Nepali. He was a speaker at WordCamp Nepal 2015 and WordCamp Kathmandu 2019 and 2023. He is a frequent speaker at WordPress meetups. He has been an instructor for web development on PHP and WordPress development-related topics.

  He has always been motivated to share the knowledge he gains and contribute to the growth and development of WordPress.

  </div>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/rolly-bueno/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-454839d0d37c0e80ff0b0a282906612b wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Rolly Bueno &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Rolly Bueno</span></a>
  Rolly has more than 15 years of experience with WordPress, working on custom solutions and leading technical projects. Despite his long journey with the platform, he only joined as an organizer last year at WordCamp Asia 2025 in Manila, where he was part of the Contributor Day team.

  This year marks his second time as a WordCamp Asia organizer, now taking on the responsibility of Co-Lead for Contributor Day in Mumbai. He is passionate about building a welcoming and impactful contributor experience, with a focus on onboarding, workshops, and helping participants deepen their involvement.

  Beyond organizing, he spends time contributing to the wider WordPress ecosystem through Core patches, testing, translations, and by building free plugins and block-based themes. Outside of WordPress, he enjoys cruising around the islands on his motorcycle, moto vlogging, and traveling to discover new places and stories.

  Diana Tupas is a Creative Director and Web Developer specializing in digital innovation. She creates visually captivating, interactive online experiences that blend strategic design and AI-driven technology into seamless, impactful solutions. Guided by a human-first approach, she structures intuitive, purposeful, and results-oriented experiences that help brands grow.

  In 2018, she co-designed the first WordCamp event in her local community in Iloilo and has been passionate about the WordPress community ever since.

  As she journeyed through the industry, Diana adopted a dog named Website — her “pup-fessional” WordPress Designer & Developer. He’s a very fur-iendly paw-worker, though he’s known to nap often and enjoys his break times more than his work sessions 😁

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/pooja-srivastava/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-baff0617cfd44b9d933d4597c56da439 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Pooja Srivastava &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Pooja Srivastava</span></a>
  Pooja is a Web Designer and Developer based in Mumbai, India. She is a WordPress enthusiast and has been involved with the platform since 2017. She has volunteered at WordCamp Bengaluru 2025, WordCamp Pune 2024, and WordCamp Mumbai 2023, and she regularly attends WordPress Mumbai meetups.

  Creative design is her passion, and she enjoys contributing as a graphic design volunteer to various NGOs. She also stays updated with the latest technology and design trends to continually enhance her work.

  In her free time, she volunteers with a local cat NGO and teaches art to children. She enjoys exploring different forms of music, art, and games. A devoted nature and animal lover, she believes in compassion and kindness toward every living being and strives to use her skills to make a positive difference wherever she can. 😸

  Junko Nukaga lives on a small island in Japan called Ogijima. She works as a freelance web designer and is the director of a non-profit library.\
  She has been part of the organizing teams of WordCamps, Meetups, and do_action events in Japan, and has also led diversity speaker training initiatives.\
  She currently contributes to the WordPress project as a Japanese Team Locale Manager and General Translation Editor, as well as a Global Community Program Manager.

  Sweta Shrestha is a Digital Marketing and SEO Specialist at Zurel Soft, a construction management software company. Her journey with the WordPress community began in 2014, when she attended WordCamp Kathmandu for the first time. In 2015, she joined the organizing team for WordCamp Kathmandu, contributing to event planning and community engagement.

  Since then, Sweta has remained actively involved in the WordPress community, helping organize monthly WordPress meetups in Kathmandu. Over the years, she has contributed her expertise in communication, coordination, and digital promotion to foster community growth and strengthen engagement within the local WordPress network.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/aditya-shah/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-bad44fee7b5177294d3403a565596728 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Aditya Shah</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Aditya Shah</span></a>
  Aditya Shah is a WordPress evangelist, tech enthusiast, and community builder from Bhopal, India. He leads the Hosting Support team at WPMU DEV and has been contributing to the WordPress ecosystem for over a decade.

  In 2015, Aditya founded the WordPress Bhopal Meetup chapter, which has since grown into a vibrant local community. Over the years, he has been actively involved in WordCamps, do_action charity hackathons, and educational initiatives such as the WP Build Tour — introducing over 1,500 students to WordPress and open-source technologies through hands-on workshops.

  Beyond WordPress, Aditya contributes to the wider tech ecosystem through events like DevFest, Cloud Community Day, and Global Azure Bootcamp in Bhopal — fostering collaboration among developers, designers, and students.

  His mission is simple: to make WordPress more accessible, secure, and welcoming for everyone, while empowering the next generation of contributors and creators.

  Connect:\
  LinkedIn – <https://www.linkedin.com/in/ethicaladitya>\
  WordPress.org – <a href="https://profiles.wordpress.org/adityashah/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">https://profiles.wordpress.org/adityashah/</a>

  *Zeel was a contributor for the first few months for WordCamp Asia 2026. This <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/in-loving-memory-of-zeel-thakkar/" data-type="post" data-id="4395">profile here is in memoriam</a>.*

  Zeel Thakkar was a freelance WordPress developer with extensive experience in building and maintaining WordPress websites. Zeel is an active contributor to the WordPress community, participating in various initiatives and events. As a proud and engaged member of the vibrant WordPress Ahmedabad community, Zeel consistently seeks opportunities to collaborate, share knowledge, and contribute to the growth of the community. She is also actively involved with the Training Team, developing educational resources that empower and educate WordPress users.

  In 2025, Zeel was honored as one of the Kim Parsell Scholarship Recipients at WordCamp Asia, a recognition that highlights her commitment and potential within the WordPress ecosystem.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/pooja-derashri/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-89fa80ed807c95f69f9a0ebb898c8323 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Pooja Derashri &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Pooja Derashri</span></a>
  Pooja is the Co-founder of WPVibes, a plugin development company based in India. She began contributing to WordPress in 2017 and has been actively involved in various teams, including Test, Training, and Community. Pooja serves as a Team Rep for the WordPress Community team and as a Program Manager in the Community team. She was the Team Rep for Test and Trainng teams in past, she also played a crucial role as a Test Lead for the WordPress 6.3 and 6.4 release squads. Additionally, Pooja co-organizes the Ajmer WordPress Meetup. In recognition of her significant contributions to WordPress, Pooja was awarded the prestigious Kim Parsell scholarship by the WordPress Foundation.

  Pratik is a dedicated Web Developer and active contributor to the WordPress.org community. With a strong focus on performance optimization, SEO best practices, and custom theme and plugin development, Pratik has consistently worked to enhance the WordPress ecosystem. He has contributed by improving code quality, reporting and resolving bugs, and sharing optimized solutions that follow WordPress coding standards.

  Pratik’s involvement extends to developing tools and custom plugins that simplify complex workflows for developers and site owners. He’s passionate about open-source collaboration and frequently engages in community discussions, helping others troubleshoot technical issues and adopt efficient development practices. His contributions aim to make WordPress faster, more accessible, and more secure for everyone.

  Beyond code, Pratik actively promotes the WordPress mission of democratizing publishing by encouraging knowledge sharing and best practices among developers and content creators. His consistent engagement and contributions demonstrate a commitment to helping WordPress evolve while empowering others to build better, more performant websites.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/arun-shenoy/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-76644115503805c746f013ed59c463a2 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Arun Shenoy</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Arun Shenoy</span></a>
  Arun Shenoy is a Software Engineer at Newfold Digital (Bluehost), where he has spent the past three years improving how people experience WordPress. His work focuses on enhancing usability and performance while exploring how emerging technologies like AI can make website creation smarter and more intuitive. Arun has worked across several areas of WordPress, including block themes, migrations, plugin development, and performance optimization, always aiming to make complex tools feel simple and approachable for everyday users.\
  He is also an active contributor to the open-source WordPress community. Arun believes in building technology that empowers creators and small businesses, making the web more accessible and efficient for everyone.\
  When he is not coding, Arun enjoys playing badminton, cricket or the violin.

  Nidhi Jain is a seasoned WordPress Developer and Technical Support Specialist with a passion for innovation and community building.

  Nidhi’s journey goes beyond code. She’s a dedicated contributor to the WordPress community. Whether it’s sharing insights at WordCamps, offering technical guidance, or actively participating in community forums, Nidhi is committed to the spirit of collaboration.

  She has been contributing to WordPress community as a theme & plugin developer, core contributor, WordPress Translator, Meetup Organizer, WordCamp Organizer and Speaker. She is one of the active member of her local community in Udaipur and lead organizer of WordCamp Udaipur 2023 and have been part of the WordCamp Asia 2023 organizing team.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/sandeep-kumar/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-1c2727bf606211eb206c6dbaa83685da wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Sandeep Kumar</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Sandeep Kumar</span></a>
  Sandeep is a seasoned sales and growth consultant with over 11 years in the WordPress ecosystem, helping companies design scalable, user-focused strategies. He has led global teams across product, partnerships, and enterprise sales, and now partners with businesses to build thoughtful, sustainable growth models through strategic consulting.

  Beyond work, Sandeep co-runs Phoodiemonk, a home-based kitchen in Pune where he and his mother are reviving old, forgotten recipes and traditional cooking methods. This passion for preserving authenticity mirrors his belief that technology, like food, should connect people and stories across generations.

  At WordCamp Asia, he looks forward to exchanging ideas with founders, creators, and community builders who believe in crafting meaningful experiences that stand the test of time.

  </div>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/v-gautham-navada/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-c301220b74099fe4a079d10bd3cc3ce9 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About V Gautham Navada</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: V Gautham Navada</span></a>
  V Gautham Navada is the Founder & Director of ForthFocus, a digital solutions agency he started in 2015 after freelancing for a few years. What began as a passion project has now grown into a remote team serving 300+ clients across 8 countries.

  Gautham’s WordPress journey started back in 2011 as a blogger. Over time, his love for the platform led him into web development, where he’s built everything from government portals to business websites for global clients. Along the way, he’s also spoken at WordCamps, sharing lessons from both the technical and entrepreneurial side of his work.

  Outside of work, Gautham loves to travel and has explored 11 countries so far. He believes in community, collaboration, and using WordPress to empower people and businesses alike.

  </div>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/vanita-nandakumar/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-9ff05197e1ec2168fdb80711e24597d9 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Vanita Nandakumar</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Vanita Nandakumar</span></a>
  With a career that’s danced across the entire agency spectrum, from client services and content to design, digital marketing, and operations. I thrive at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and execution. I’ve built my experience in diverse industries including fire safety, film & media, medical, and most recently, in the world of WordPress as Operations Manager at Human Made until June 2024.

  I’ve been an active contributor to the global WordPress community since 2021 through the WordPress Polyglots Team (covering 8 languages!) and have proudly taken on leadership roles, from Team Lead Operations for WordCamp Asia 2024, to Team Lead Communications for WordCamp Asia 2025, and now serving as Co-Lead Sponsors for WordCamp Asia 2026.

  For the past six years, I’ve also been running my own digital marketing agency, Riot Minds, helping brands stand out, scale up, and truly connect with their audiences. Beyond the big stages, I’ve also contributed locally as an organiser for WordPress Tamil Nadu for two years.

  In short: I live and breathe storytelling, strategy, and community. And I love turning bold ideas into real, measurable impact.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/amitkumar-dudhat/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-9a8b4a6b72b15d0db53695dbed8c2d0b wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Amitkumar Dudhat &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Amitkumar Dudhat</span></a>
  I’m Amitkumar Dudhat, a WordPress professional with over 8 years of experience in web development. I specialize in website development, theme and plugin customization, developing custom Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks, and integrating solutions with WooCommerce.

  I am an active WordPress contributor, having contributed to WordPress Core 5.2, 5.3, and as a Translation Contributor, reflecting my dedication to open-source. Locally, I host the WordPress Surat Meetup, fostering collaboration and community growth.

  As part of WordCamp Asia 2026, I aim to combine my technical expertise, organizational skills, and community spirit to help deliver a meaningful and impactful event.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/chetan-prajapati/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-24ee029506ea8dfadd85cb52a8f74f06 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Chetan Prajapati &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Chetan Prajapati</span></a>
  Chetan is a dedicated WordPress enthusiast, a versatile freelancer, and an accomplished WordPress developer. His career journey commenced with PHP, which laid the foundation for his deep dive into the WordPress ecosystem. Over the past ten years, Chetan has honed his skills, specializing in website development, theme and plugin customization, and the complete lifecycle of web design, development, and rigorous testing.

  As an active contributor to WordPress, Chetan has left his mark on both minor and major releases, beginning with version 4.9. He earned recognition as a noteworthy contributor for versions 5.1, 5.2, and 5.3, showcasing his commitment to WordPress. Beyond this, Chetan actively lends his expertise to WordPress Core, Training, WordPressTV, Accessibility, and other contribution areas.

  Chetan also served as an organizer for WordCamp Asia 2025, further demonstrating his dedication to the global WordPress community.

  When he’s not immersed in work or the WordPress world, you’ll find Chetan exploring new horizons through travel, photography, cruising on his bike, and enthusiastically participating in WordCamps—a testament to his unwavering passion for WordPress.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/juhi-patel/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-5da9b4c2163c17ead22196bb06b75f75 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Juhi Patel &gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Juhi Patel</span></a>
  Juhi Patel is an Assistant Professor at GLS University, where she passionately shares her knowledge and expertise with her students. She has been actively involved in the WordPress community as a member of the Ahmedabad WordPress and Ahmedabad WooCommerce Meetup groups. Her journey with WordPress began in 2017 when she volunteered at WordCamp Ahmedabad, her first WordCamp, which she describes as an amazing experience. Since then, she has contributed to various WordCamps, learning new things and connecting with others who shares their passion for WordPress.

  She is currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, focusing on AI-driven recommendation systems and sustainable technologies.

  Juhi contributes to Core, Polyglots, WPTV, Plugins, and Training, and has developed several plugins, including theme. She also volunteered at WordCamp Asia 2025, which added to her enriching experiences.

  - <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/amar-sawant-wp07/" class="wp-block-social-link-anchor" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," /><span class="wp-block-social-link-label screen-reader-text">LinkedIn</span></a>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/amar-arjun-sawant/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-8a0629489baa3a93660a3c44ea11e879 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Amar Arjun Sawant</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Amar Arjun Sawant</span></a>
  I’ve been actively involved in the WordPress community for several years, starting my journey by volunteering at WordCamps in Mumbai and Pune since 2016. These experiences helped me connect with inspiring people and learn from the vibrant WordPress ecosystem.

  In 2025, I had the opportunity to attend and sponsor WordCamp Kolhapur, as well as participate in WordCamp Pune, which further deepened my connection with the community. Along the way, I’ve also conducted a session for the WordPress Mumbai community, sharing knowledge and encouraging open discussions.

  Beyond events, I contribute to WordPress Marathi translations, helping make WordPress more accessible to local users. For me, WordCamps are more than just events—they’re spaces where ideas grow, friendships form, and collaboration thrives. I’m excited to bring this passion and experience to WordCamp Asia 2026 as part of the organizing team.

  </div>

  Sanyogg Shelar is the mastermind of technology and business, driving innovation and growth at Version Next Technologies. With a Master’s degree in Technology and Business Administration, he brings 17 years of expertise in software development, system architecture, and strategic leadership.

  A passionate programmer and architect, Sanyogg specializes in designing secure, scalable systems and delivering enterprise-grade solutions. At Vodote.com, a cybersecurity company, he contributes his deep knowledge of infrastructure security and threat protection, helping organizations strengthen defenses against evolving digital risks. His expertise extends to server management, offering clients practical guidance on managing and safeguarding critical web applications.

  Beyond technology, Sanyogg shares valuable insights into cybersecurity best practices, programming, and architecture, empowering businesses to thrive securely in the digital age. His rare blend of technical mastery and business acumen enables him to craft innovative solutions while guiding organizations toward sustainable success.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/abhishek-deshpande/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-f190612d0cfb2212dadf41d603895ebe wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Abhishek Deshpande</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Abhishek Deshpande</span></a>
  Abhishek Deshpande is an open-source enthusiast and community contributor from Nagpur, India. His journey with WordPress began as a curiosity for the web and evolved into a deep commitment to community building, collaboration, and open learning.

  He actively contributes to the ecosystem through meetups, WordCamps, and translation projects, helping more people experience the freedom and creativity of open-source technology. Passionate about digital inclusion, Abhishek loves creating spaces where developers, designers, and learners can connect, share knowledge, and grow together.

  Beyond WordPress, he enjoys exploring new technologies, AI tools, and ways to make the web more accessible and meaningful for everyone.

  Amit Singh is the founder of WPoets, a WordPress agency building Awesome Websites for sass companies.

  A conference junkie, he gets withdrawal symptoms if he doesn’t go to one for six months or doesn’t organise for two years. When that happens, you just have to say PHP or WordPress ten times and he’s fine!

  On a serious note, Amit has been involved in most of the WordCamps in India and has helped organise WordCamp Pune.

  Moses Musoke Ssebunya is a WordPress professional with over six years of experience in development, testing, and community engagement. Since 2018, he has contributed as a developer, translator, and tester, and has led teams on various WordPress projects. An active member of the WordPress Community Team, Moses has spoken at WordCamps in Masaka, Entebbe, and Nairobi, and organized local meetups in Uganda. In recognition of his dedication to the open-source community, he was awarded the Yoast Care Fund. Moses is passionate about improving WordPress through testing and fostering collaboration across the community.

  </div>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/muhammad-kashif/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-7d928cd4eecf1a40f89c1790bfb4833d wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Muhammad Kashif</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Muhammad Kashif</span></a>
  Kashif is a WordPress enthusiast and Codeable Expert passionate about empowering others through education and community leadership. He served as Co-Lead for the Volunteers Team at WordCamp Asia 2025, ensuring a seamless and memorable experience for hundreds of contributors and attendees. A former Lead Organizer of WordCamp Lahore 2019 and volunteer at WordCamp Europe 2022 and 2023, Kashif has been deeply involved in the WordPress ecosystem for over a decade. His WordPress training programs have reached more than 160,000 students across Pakistan an achievement highlighted by Matt Mullenweg during the Q&A session at WordCamp Asia 2025. As a WordCamp speaker and mentor, Kashif continues to inspire and nurture the next generation of WordPress professionals. When not immersed in WordPress, he draws creativity from his travels and cultural experiences.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/pantira-aswakiatkajorn/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-85da1d0a48f050c24fba527b31c25c57 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Pantira Aswakiatkajorn</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Pantira Aswakiatkajorn</span></a>
  I’m Yugi, a Translation Contributor and a passionate community organizer. I have been familiar with WordPress since 2009, using it as a regular user while I was a student.

  My official journey into the WordPress community began in 2014. I was introduced to the community by Shinichi, following a recommendation from a friend at Hubba who asked, “Do you know the group of WordPress users in Thailand?”

  Since then, I have dedicated myself to building and supporting the local and regional community. I helped gather friends to organize the first Meetups, which eventually led to the creation of WordCamp Bangkok. This work later evolved into being part of the organizing team for WordCamp Asia.

  I am honored to be a part of this community work, collaborating with organizers from many countries, and I continue to serve as a WordCamp Organizer.

  </div>

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/shamali-sulakhe/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-cdd9f9062dc6795d8015cdbaf5ebc774 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Shamali Sulakhe</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Shamali Sulakhe</span></a>
  Shamali is a polite and passionate WordPress geek. A Technical Leader with over 8 years of experience, her expertise spans project management, development, performance optimization, website scaling, security, and migration.

  Starting her journey as a WordPress developer in 2017, Shamali has taken on multiple roles from developer and mentor to technical leader. She finds her interest in structured project planning and team leadership.

  Apart from her work, she enjoys contributing to the community and knowledge sharing. She has participated in several WordCamps and tech events as a speaker, panel judge, and organizer.

  <a href="https://asia.wordcamp.org/2026/organizer/subrata-sarkar/" class="more_about_organizer wp-elements-9254f42a4b7f4125365ef4e8d6cb8ce9 wp-block-read-more has-text-color has-contrast-2-color" target="_self"><span style="text-decoration: underline">More About Subrata Sarkar</span> <span style="text-decoration: underline">&gt;</span><span class="screen-reader-text">: Subrata Sarkar</span></a>
  I am a Web and Platform developer at emfluence Digital Agency, Kansas City, USA, working remotely from my hometown, Kolkata, India. I very much love to contribute to WordPress in whatever way I am able to, whether it is core, plugin, Polyglots or anything else.

  In addition to the WordPress development and contribution to the platform, I am passionate about developing Alexa skills. Have done a few already based on clients’ demands. I have been organizing Meetups and WordCamps for the local Kolkata WordPress Community since 2017. So far I have led two WordCamps and have been in the core organizing team of the only CareerCamp on behalf of the Kolkata WordPress Community.

  I am extremely passionate about trekking in the Himalayas, educational travels, gardening, and also love to save the memories staying behind the lens!
